stories.title: Godwin Heights Board of Education holds first meeting since student's fatal crash
stories.summary: Godwin Heights Public Schools superintendent, Chad Conklin, shared a message of support for the grieving family and school community during Monday's meeting.

stories.title: Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express returns for the holidays
stories.summary: The Gerald R. Ford Presidential Express, a tribute to Ford's Michigan legacy, returns to the museum Nov. 27 through Jan. 3, 2027.

stories.title: Muskegon Heights council moves forward on interim city manager search, debates vacant mayor's seat
stories.summary: Muskegon Heights leaders voted to interview two interim city manager candidates but took no action on the city's vacant mayoral seat Monday night.

stories.title: Walker commission approves Axon contract with license plate readers, drones
stories.summary: The Walker City Commission approved a $3.6M Axon contract, replacing Flock cameras with a new system that includes 10 license plate readers.

stories.title: 'Truly one of a kind' | Family remembers 12-year-old girl who died in Wyoming
stories.summary: Family members are remembering 12-year-old Taryn Thomas, who was killed when her e-bike collided with a school bus in Wyoming. Loved ones are asking for support.

stories.title: 'Prolonged uncertainty' | Only one finalist remains in Mason County sheriff search
stories.summary: Undersheriff Derrek Wilson withdrew his name from the running in early November, citing the "tremendous toll" the process had taken on the agency.

stories.title: 'Indefensible': Gas prices jump ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Prices at some stations jumped as high as 50 cents per gallon. One petroleum analyst says there's no reason for it.

stories.title: Gas expert calls jump in prices at some Michigan stations 'indefensible'
stories.summary: Despite Michigan gas prices dropping on Monday, some stations are selling gas for a price an expert said he couldn't defend.

stories.title: Three arrested in Calhoun County child exploitation investigation
stories.summary: Three men were arrested during a Calhoun County operation targeting people suspected of using social media to solicit minors for sexual encounters.

stories.title: City selects next chief for Battle Creek Police Department
stories.summary: After a nationwide search, Battle Creek selected Rudy Alcaraz to serve as BCPD's next police chief.

stories.title: Police seize kilo of cocaine, pounds of meth in Kalamazoo
stories.summary: Two men were arrested after Kalamazoo police seized a kilogram of cocaine, six pounds of methamphetamine, fentanyl and firearms during a drug investigation.

stories.title: Kalamazoo expands recycling efforts downtown for take-out cups, containers
stories.summary: Kalamazoo unveils a new recycling campaign to promote eco-friendly disposal of take-out cups and containers downtown.
